_rationale: Spending $300k forces a large taxable-account withdrawal at MAGI well above the $200k single NIIT threshold. Withdrawal w satisfies w·0.962 + 7600 = 300000 + 0.15w → solving: w − 0.15w − 0.038(w − 200000) = 300000 → 0.812w = 292400 → w = 360,098.52. Federal LTCG = 0.15·w = 54,014.78. State LTCG = 0 (Florida). NIIT = 0.038·(w − 200,000) = 6,083.74. Total tax 60,098.52; net cash flow 0. Balance after year 1 = 1,000,000 − 360,098.52 = 639,901.48.
